scenes.name: THE VERDICT
lines: Fourteen chapters on one Behrend shell. Time to close the ledger.
十四章，都落在同一个贝伦德球壳上。是时候合上账本了。
Four out of four questions have a witness inside the model.
四问中的四问，在模型内都有显式见证。
Zero out of four are derived without fitting.
四问中的零问，能无拟合地推出。
Both numbers are true at once.
两个数字同时为真。

scenes.name: THE BALANCE SHEET
lines: Gauge crossing: with d 724 and k 32, two-loop running gives alpha strong near 0.1184.
规范交汇：取 d = 724、k = 32，两圈跑动给出 α_s ≈ 0.1184。
Generations: at cut nine, 67 of the first 8,192 zeros leave three light modes.
三代：分界取 9 时，前 8,192 枚零点中有 67 枚在五种超荷上各留三个轻模。
Flavor: on one flagship zero, two CKM quantities land within 1.33 parts per million.
味：在一枚旗舰零点上，两项 CKM 量落到 1.33 ppm 以内。
Gravity: a spin-two pole, and four heat-kernel layers hit the curvature within 0.2 percent.
引力：自旋二引力子极点；四层热核真空能命中曲率至千分之二以内。
Each left cell rests on chosen inputs. A witness, not a derivation.
左栏每一格都依赖指定的输入：是见证，不是推导。
Each right cell is still open, from the Higgs mass to dark energy.
右栏每一格仍然开放，从希格斯质量直到暗能量。

scenes.name: FIVE TENSIONS
lines: Tension one: share the arithmetic clock with flavor, and the seventh time is forced 4,130 steps off.
张力一：算术钟与夸克味共用权重，第七项时间被迫偏离参考值 4,130 格。
Two: the joint vacuum needs 105 windings, then leaves a hundred-dimensional family.
其二：共同真空需要 105 圈，随后留下一个 100 维的连续可行族。
Three: five selection rules crown five different zeros.
其三：五条选点准则，拥立五枚不同的零点。
Four: fitting the masses pushes a heavy Yukawa block above 16.63, and the vacuum balance breaks.
其四：拟合质量把重—重汤川块推过 16.63，真空配平随之撞毁。
Five: induced gravity gives lambda G above 0.0118, against ten to the minus 122.
其五：诱导引力给出 ΛG > 0.01180，而目标是 10⁻¹²² 量级。
Press one end of the log down, and another springs up.
按下浮木的一端，另一端就弹起来。

scenes.name: FOUR OPEN PROBLEMS
lines: So the four questions become four refined open problems.
于是四问被磨成四个精炼的开放问题。
One: derive thresholds, the Higgs mass, and the choice of zero, from one partition function.
第一问：从单一配分函数推出重阈值、希格斯质量与零点选择。
Two: let dynamics, not a chosen cut, select exactly three generations.
第二问：让动力学而非人为分界，选出恰好三代。
Three: one flavor law across zeros, and a verdict on proton decay.
第三问：一条跨零点的统一味律，并裁决质子衰变。
Four: Lorentzian gravity, Newton's constant, and a dark energy small without tuning.
第四问：洛伦兹引力、牛顿常数，以及无需微调就极小的暗能量。

scenes.name: ONE EXAM
lines: None stands alone. The zero chosen in problem one fixes the background of problem three.
四问无一能单独解决：第一问选定的零点，决定第三问的背景。
Two feeds one and four; four loops back on one and three.
第二问进入第一问与第四问；第四问又反过来锁紧第一问与第三问。
So a future master connection faces one exam: all four bars at once, no dial turned afterwards.
所以未来的主联络只有一场考试：同时过四道门槛，事后不许拧任何旋钮。
Four witnesses, zero shortcuts.
四处见证，零条捷径。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Unification, chapter fifteen.
《OMEGA 统一》· 第十五章
